title: Fortnite CEO all in on AI
author: TheUniverseOrNothing
selftext: And the Xbox labs announcement… it’s time to go all in on AI game building.

comments.author: TheUniverseOrNothing
comments.body:
I’ve posted this thought here before but I am still seriously considering moving to Reno (no income tax, less crowded than Vegas) and I will open up my AI game studio.

These major companies keep screwing us. I do feel for the individuals working on these games but I don’t care at all if bungie fails and some team of 5 devs they fired builds a better destiny/halo.

Imagine having 5 ambitious people who actually care about gaming (and know what they are doing or can be trained) that all are running multiple Claude 20x subscriptions focused on one project. Opus 5.5 has really been cooking for me.

Edit: no idea why this comment triggered people. I have experience marketing for gaming studios and have owned my own business for years but have never built games before AI. Sorry I’m bit of a dreamer….

replies.author: SwaggyK
replies.body: lmfao...lets see your portfolio

replies.author: TheUniverseOrNothing
replies.body:
Damn I forgot I need a stranger on Reddit named SwaggyK to validate me and give me permission…

I’ve owned a marketing business for 10 years if I want to pivot that’s on me. Don’t be weird.

replies.body:
😮 Wow look at Mr.Successful here 

Hilarious you're telling others not to be weird as well lmfao
Edit: 😂😂 Went and deleted everything, nice.

replies.author: TheUniverseOrNothing
replies.body:
Why is Reddit so weird.

Why can’t you just stay on topic.

I posted an idea, why do I need to validate and prove to strangers anything.

Also why can’t Reddit accept that adults that have been on this earth 30-40 years own businesses. It’s not even that crazy. I’m just an average guy. It’s not a flex. I’m just saying I understand how to manage business. Jeeez

replies.author: TheUniverseOrNothing
replies.body: Sorry I just don’t understand the Reddit circlejerk game you people play.

replies.author: SwaggyK
replies.body: How about we rephrase this to; guy seriously considering opening up a game studio with no portfolio or experience. Now who is the weird one?

replies.author: ArialBear
replies.body: Something is wrong with you. There is no reason to even push back unless you personally feel attacked. Youre very weird

replies.author: Armandeluz
replies.body: Imagine having five ambitious people that have no idea what they're doing all wasting your money at the same time.

replies.author: TheUniverseOrNothing
replies.body: You know it’s possible to work with other professionals… like my friend who got laid off from bungie who’s building on the side is what is making me realize how quickly the industry is shifting. Why is Reddit so negative lmao. I’m sure it will be a waste of time for most people, welcome to business.

replies.author: mccoypauley
replies.body: Hey man, I think it's an ambitious and cool idea. Especially since you have a business background. I'm sorry everyone else behaves like children. As a freelancer myself, fucking off to try to make shit with AI to see where it takes me (with likeminded people) would be a dream.

replies.author: TheUniverseOrNothing
replies.body:
I don’t take it personally, I remember 15 years ago my own friend group told me “you don’t have to lie to kick it” when I said I was making money online lol. It didn’t make sense to me because it wasn’t anything insane, I was running Facebook ads for a hearing aid company.

This AI space is 10x more cruel. And “starting an ai game studio in Reno” does sound pretty crazy but I’m pretty confident in the idea with my marketing background. I’ve been leveraging AI for existing clients and have been using professionally for years. I’m actually building an IOS app for a client and have 3 people working on this. But anyways…

I was just hoping to spark convo with other people who have thought similar.

replies.author: mccoypauley
replies.body: I hope it works. I myself am a web developer, been reshaping how I do my own work with AI. Frantically trying to get my own web presence revamped with an AI-as-orchestrator message, because my colleagues are light years behind. Now is the time to act, so kudos to you for considering this step.

replies.author: SeasawPhilosopher
replies.body: This sub hates ambition. I posted a comment about how I want my game to sell 100k copies (while admitting the challenges), and people downvoted me and called me delusional. Ignore the haters and dream big!

replies.author: TheUniverseOrNothing
replies.body:
3.5 billion people play video games of some sort.

You can hit 100k no problem. 

Most of the people saying you can’t won’t even build anything or try.

replies.author: SeasawPhilosopher
replies.body: Thank you brother! Happy building and good luck

replies.author: redditscraperbot2
replies.body: What do you mean? It’s no weirder than the very common title, Gabe Newell, CEO of counter strike.

comments.author: shadow_fen
comments.body: I'm skeptical on how good it'll actually be for Fortnite. It's a crazy complex game, and I just don't see AI working on that level, not for another year or two at least.

replies.author: TheUniverseOrNothing
replies.body:
I think he just sees the future and where it’s heading more so than the tech is 100% ready today.

But seeing how fast it’s advancing 1-2 years I can’t imagine what it will be like.

replies.author: Bromit
replies.body: just like AI help in big tech company with complex product. Most probably Fortnite is already divided in multiple micro components/service, where AI can easily increase productivity.

replies.author: SeasawPhilosopher
replies.body: That doesn’t square with reality though as all big tech companies are using AI on their multi million line extremely complex codebases. Obviously games are different, and the ability to complete game related tasks by agents is lacking in many areas. However, I don’t think you can argue that it’s simply a size and complexity problem.

comments.body: Fortnite is already slop so it makes sense

replies.author: ScutFarkush
replies.body: Fortnite is literally the most polished BR. I used to be a hater too, but then I started playing with my teenagers and was very surprised at how not sloppy it is.
